_readme: The shipped starting list of Focus Tasks/Duties for the Business Owner Expectations model (item 5.3). Copied from design/report-source-models/BO Expectations.xlsx, sheet 'Business Owners Data Entry', D16:D25, in the workbook's order and words. Any managing tier may replace it on the hub's Owner Focus Tasks tab; each owner may then change their own copy on the model. See server/utils/ownerFocusTasks.js.
